content.user_title: Build Molecular ML Workflows with DeepChem
content.value_statement: Molecular ML projects require careful featurization, splitting, and model selection. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical DeepChem workflows for reliable experiments.
actual_capabilities: Guides loading molecular data from SMILES, SDF files, CSV files, and protein sequences.
Recommends DeepChem featurizers for fingerprints, descriptors, graph models, sequence models, and 3D inputs.
Provides workflows for scaffold splitting, normalization, model training, evaluation, and prediction.
Covers MoleculeNet benchmark datasets for classification, regression, quantum, and materials tasks.
Includes scripts for solubility prediction, graph neural networks, and transfer learning experiments.
Explains metrics for classification and regression model evaluation.
limitations: Scientific results still need domain review and experimental validation.
DeepChem and its optional dependencies must be installed in the user environment.
Large datasets and graph models may require substantial memory or GPU resources.
Pretrained models and benchmark loaders may download external model or dataset files.

use_cases.title: Screen Candidate Molecules
use_cases.description: Build a property prediction workflow that loads SMILES data, applies featurization, and evaluates model quality.

use_cases.title: Benchmark Molecular Models
use_cases.description: Compare DeepChem models on MoleculeNet datasets with scaffold splits and consistent evaluation metrics.

use_cases.title: Prototype Transfer Learning
use_cases.description: Fine-tune pretrained molecular models for small datasets and compare results with simpler baselines.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Featurizer
prompt_templates.prompt: I have molecular data with SMILES strings and one target property. Recommend a DeepChem featurizer and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Baseline Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a DeepChem workflow for my CSV dataset with scaffold splitting, normalization, a baseline model, and regression metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Compare GNN Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me compare GCN, GAT, AttentiveFP, and MPNN for a molecular classification task with limited training data.

prompt_templates.title: Design Transfer Learning
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a DeepChem transfer learning experiment using a pretrained molecular model, a small custom dataset, and leakage-resistant evaluation.

output_examples.input: Recommend a first DeepChem workflow for a solubility CSV with SMILES and measured values.
output: Start with circular fingerprints and a scaffold split.
Train a simple regression baseline before graph neural networks.
Report R2, mean absolute error, and root mean squared error.

output_examples.input: Help me choose a model for a small BBBP classification study.
output: Use scaffold splitting to reduce leakage from similar molecules.
Try a fingerprint baseline and a pretrained molecular model.
Compare ROC-AUC on validation and test sets.

output_examples.input: Explain how to avoid common DeepChem evaluation mistakes.
output: Avoid random splits for drug discovery unless the study requires them.
Fit normalization only from training data.
Use metrics that match the task type and class balance.

best_practices: Use scaffold splitting for molecular property prediction unless another split is scientifically justified.
Start with simple fingerprint baselines before training graph neural networks.
Validate model outputs with chemistry expertise before making research decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not report random-split results as evidence of real-world generalization.
Do not fine-tune pretrained models before checking a simple baseline.
Do not treat prediction scores as laboratory evidence or clinical guidance.

faq.question: What does this skill help me build?
faq.answer: It helps build DeepChem workflows for molecular data loading, featurization, model training, evaluation, and prediction.

faq.question: Does it include runnable examples?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes example scripts for solubility prediction, graph neural networks, and transfer learning.

faq.question: Can it choose the best model automatically?
faq.answer: No. It recommends candidates and evaluation plans, but the user must compare results on appropriate data.

faq.question: Does it require DeepChem installation?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflows require DeepChem and may require optional PyTorch or model dependencies.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows for DeepChem development.

faq.question: Is this suitable for medical decisions?
faq.answer: No. It supports research workflows only and does not replace laboratory, clinical, or regulatory review.
